Name: New TV Channels including Romance of The Three Kingdoms etc.
Author: RaistBunnies
Description:
基于前置mod：Custom TV Channel (nexus:24278)。制作参考了星露谷wiki（https://bx4kwkz0eqb.feishu.cn/wiki/YLzDwIWQainnskkKzWdcBgNanag）和mod：TV channel - gardening with Hisame (nexus:5485)。谢谢！
目前只支持中文，因为萌新不知道怎么加入多种语言（）
This work is based on the mod 'Custom TV Channel' (nexus:24278). To finish this I also referred to the stardew mod wiki:  https://bx4kwkz0eqb.feishu.cn/wiki/YLzDwIWQainnskkKzWdcBgNanag , and the mod 'TV channel - gardening with Hisame' (nexus:5485). Thank you all!
Now it only supports Chinese because I have no idea how to add more languages, I'm just a beginner

Downloads.Description:
解压后TV Channels文件夹放在“Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods”目录下

after unzipping, put the TV Channels folder under the Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods directory

Manifest.Name: TVChannelsIncludingRomanceOfTheThreeKingdoms
Manifest.Description: Added some TV series to your TV, including 'Romance of The Three Kingdoms' (1994). This work is based on the mod 'Custom TV Channel' (nexus:24278). To finish this I also referred to the stardew mod wiki: https://bx4kwkz0eqb.feishu.cn/wiki/YLzDwIWQainnskkKzWdcBgNanag , and the mod 'TV channel - gardening with Hisame' (nexus:5485). Thank you!
Manifest.Author: playsanguoshaplayde
